culpritSource.quote: Takagi, by following Conan's orders, says in front of Utagawa that the information Komoda used for blackmailing Utagawa was found, so he immediatly goes to the park to retreive the body. They catch Utagawa red-handed, digging the location where Innami's body was buried. Conan finally sleeps Kogoro and declares that the real culprit is Juichi Innami. The dead body found is actually Tosuke Utagawa.

They catch Utagawa red-handed, digging the location where Innami's body was buried. Conan finally sleeps Kogoro and declares that the real culprit is Juichi Innami. summary.en: Kogoro and Conan discovered a corpse on the street while taking a stroll. Seemingly, the deceased have been hit in the head with a metal pipe, and remained a dying message that looks like "1-1-2". The estimated time of death is around 9PM last night, Conan visited the deceased's apartment.
